payload.reasoning: Pitch-class-profile is accepted as 12-element filter bank computing chroma features from spectrogram, persisted in MIR pipelines. The note claims it serves speech-processing for pitch contour tracking/intonation analysis/prosodic analysis/speaker characterization/speech synthesis. Pitch-class-profile definition explicitly states persisted as time-series in music information retrieval pipelines, construction deterministic, kernel centered on 12-tone equal-tempered scale. The pinned sense is music-originated chroma. Using it for speech prosody is a stretch: pitch-class-profile is a music-specific discretization; speech-processing uses F0 contours, not chroma bins. Removal test fails: speech-processing pipelines do not require 12-tone chroma bins; they use F0, formants, MFCC. SERVES conflates possible repurposing with actual operational dependency. Strike.
